system.description: For 1 hour(s), the Thuul precisely remembers travelled distances and directions. While blindfolded, make a Situation roll with SV 10. If transported unconscious, use SV 5. Failure prevents recalling the journey’s details. The rolls remain available from this effect.
system.summary: Gives the Thuul a supernatural memory of the way and helps them find their path again.
